sentences.en: I leaned forward, eager to catch every word he spoke.
sentences.zh: 我向前倾身，热切地想听他说的每一句话。

sentences.en: I'm eager to be allowed to do more private-sector investment.
sentences.zh: 我渴望被允许进行更多的私营部门投资。

sentences.en: We are all eager for him to win the Nobel prize.
sentences.zh: 我们都希望他能获得诺贝尔奖。
